Classic Bobotie

Ingredients: 500 g beef mince, 1 onion, 2 slices of bread soaked in milk, 2 tablespoons curry powder, 1 tablespoon chutney, a handful of raisins, 2 eggs and 250 ml milk for the topping.

Fry the onion until soft, add the curry powder and mince and cook until browned. Stir in the soaked bread, chutney and raisins. Spoon into a baking dish, whisk the eggs with the milk, pour over the top and bake at 180 degrees for 35 minutes. Serve with yellow rice.
